title: A New Feature for Instagram Users 🎶
body: A New Feature for Instagram Users 🎶

Instagram added a button to save songs to Apple Music directly from the app: link your Apple Music account, tap “Add to Apple Music” on any song, and it is automatically saved to a playlist called “Instagram Songs.”
Simply put: instead of searching for the song manually in the music app, it is now saved with one tap. The feature is similar to the Spotify shortcut that has existed for two years.
The announcement also extended the time allowed to edit stories to 15 minutes, a feature we covered previously.
Do you use Apple Music or Spotify to save songs from Instagram?
